limitations.quote: +    always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
limitations.note: The patch clocked the shift register but left `data` combinational, so it exposes the rotated state instead of sampling the pre-edge state and advances the visible sequence by one clock.
The test expected pattern index 1 on the first rising edge after reset release rather than index 0, so it accepted the same one-clock phase error as the patch.
